_note: The Germanic family: continental Germanic/Gothic, Norse, Anglo-Saxon, and Frankish/OHG branches of one tongue. Members split between clanhold (Alani, Vargari, Cwealmingas, Alaman) and feudal (Merovan, Ostran) government. Base provides the concept inventory, morphology template, shared roots, both title-ladder structures, and the common-Germanic theonym ancestor set; each culture realizes its branch's phonology and its reflexes of the shared theonyms. Orthography in the data is ASCII: write the thorn as 'th', eth as 'dh', ash as 'ae', o-with-umlaut as 'o' (a renderer may prettify).

phonology.palette: Germanic: voiceless and voiced stops p/t/k b/d/g, the dental fricatives th/dh, w, h, j; strong stress on the root syllable; ablaut; dithematic compounding.

sub_palette_notes.gothic: Continental/East Germanic (Alani): conservative; masc -s/-az, fem -o; th and w retained; ai/au diphthongs kept; reiks/thiudans register.
sub_palette_notes.norse: Old Norse (Vargari): nominative -r; initial w- lost before round vowels (Wod- > Od-); ai>ei, au>ey/au; th/dh; i- and u-umlaut; -son/-dottir.
sub_palette_notes.anglo_saxon: Old English (Anglo-Saxon component of Cwealmingas/Ostran): retain w-; au>ea, ai>a; th retained; weak -a endings; cyning/ealdor register.
sub_palette_notes.frankish: Frankish/Old High German (Merovan): High German consonant shift th>d, d>t, k>ch/hh; w>w/wu; endings -o/-i; comes/herizogo register.

phonology.phonotactics: CVC and clusters (st, sk, sp, br, kn, hl, hr, hw); root-initial stress; dithematic names.

lexicon_concepts._note: Same concept inventory as the other family bases; realized per branch in each culture kit.

shared_roots._note: Common-Germanic cognates recognizable across the branches (common words and titles, allowed; theophoric built only on the morphed canon-reflexes below, never real Germanic gods).
shared_roots.king: *kuningaz (Goth. thiudans, ON konungr, OE cyning, Frk. kuning)
shared_roots.lord: *fraujon / *druhtinaz (Goth. frauja, ON drottinn, OE dryhten, Frk. truhtin)

theonym_ancestors._note: Common-Germanic ancestral theonyms: phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon into a reconstructed proto-Germanic form. These are NOT real Germanic gods; they are the shared root from which each branch derives its own reflex (the *Wodanaz > Odin/Woden/Wotan model). Each culture kit lists the reflexes for its branch. ASCII: th=thorn, dh=eth, ae=ash.

reflex_rules.gothic: conservative: -az>-s, retain th and w, keep ai/au (e.g. *Erlanthaz > Erlands).
reflex_rules.norse: -az>-r; lose initial w- before round vowels; ai>ei; i-umlaut (e.g. *Numinaz > Nymir).
reflex_rules.frankish: High German shift th>d, d>t; w>wu/w; -az>-o (e.g. *Thulraz > Dulro).

morphology_template.patronymic_form: patronymic -sunus/-son/-ing (descendant of); kin/lineage name for nobility; matronymic rare.

title_ladder_structure._note: ACKS 7 tiers. Two government modes present in the family: clanhold (Alani, Vargari, Cwealmingas, Alaman) and feudal (Merovan, Ostran). Both share the kuning (king) and harja-tugon (war-leader/duke) roots; clan ladders top out at konungr/thiudans, feudal ladders run to keisar (emperor < Caesar). Tier->ruler-level mapping pending the ACKS lookup.

conventions.people_name_default: dithematic personal name + patronymic (-sunus/-son/-ing) or lineage; bynames (animal/deed/trait) for the renowned; order given-first.
conventions.transparent_vs_opaque: moderate-high; many names are transparent dithematic compounds.
